content: Blaze, suspected to have been caused by a short circuit, was brought under control; no patients were affected

content: According to Dr. NRS Government Ayurvedic College, the MoU is expected to benefit undergraduate and postgraduate students, research scholars, faculty members, and healthcare professionals

content: The police failed to address a financial dispute with a tobacco trader and instead implicated the former MLA, his son and associates in a criminal case, allege party leader Ambati Rambabau and daughter of the accused leader Noori Fathima

title: Kerala government expands operational limits of wild boar shooters to mitigate human-wildlife conflict
content: Authorised shooters selected by local self-government institutions will no longer be confined to the respective administrative limits and can be deployed across the State without any district restrictions

title: Dr. NTRUHS Vice-Chancellor calls for uniform implementation of revised Physiotherapy curriculum
content: Inaugurating an orientation programme, Dr. Chandrasekhar emphasises the need to enhance the quality of Physiotherapy education and align academic standards with the national guidelines prescribed by the NCAHP

title: CPI(ML) Liberation calls for lowering voting age to 16, questions RSS’ Gen Z outreach
content: Party General Secretary Dipankar Bhattacharya says if the RSS and the government want to listen to Gen Z, they should allow them to speak through the ballot

title: CEO reviews VB-G RAM G works in villages in Bidar
content: With the revised rural employment programme promising increased work opportunities and better income support for rural households, Bidar Zilla Panchayat Chief Executive Officer Girish Badole on Tuesday reviewed the implementation of the Viksit Bharat Grameen Rural Ajeevika for Guarantee Mission Grameen (VB-G RAM G) Scheme during a visit to Janawada village in Bidar taluk

title: Pak drone spotted in Kathua amid reports of Islamabad's military build-up along border
content: A Pakistani drone was spotted over Kathua's Hiranagar sector, prompting a security search.  Security forces also conducted a large anti-terror operation in Poonch district.  An unexploded mortar shell was recovered from a house in Kathua.  These events occur amid heightened tensions along the India-Pakistan border.  India stated it will safeguard its national interests as needed.

title: Udhayanidhi released after 90-min interrogation; big show of strength outside police stn
content: Udhayanidhi Stalin faced arrest over alleged remarks linked to actor Trisha. The Madras High Court directed his release on station bail after questioning. DMK workers staged protests across Tamil Nadu following the arrest. The TVK government and opposition engaged in a war of words. Udhayanidhi denied allegations and stated his remarks were distorted.

title: 'A rebirth for us': Passengers recall chaos after Air India flight hits turbulence
content: An Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi encountered severe turbulence on Tuesday morning. The aircraft briefly lost altitude, causing injuries to 17 passengers and crew members. One cabin crew member sustained severe injuries, while others had minor wounds. Passengers described the terrifying ordeal, with some being thrown from their seats. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has launched a thorough investigation into the incident.

title: Pakistan boxer Qudratullah ‘goes missing’ in Glasgow after CWG campaign
content: Pakistani boxer Qudratullah reportedly went missing in Glasgow hours before the national team’s departure, with his passport and return ticket remaining with the team manager. Pakistan finished the Commonwealth Games with just one medal, a bronze for Fatima Zahra. Her historic achievement made her the first Pakistani female boxer to win a CWG medal, while Arshad Nadeem missed out.

title: Will Nifty & Sensex continue to diverge? What new stock market timings mean
content: As per SEBI guidelines, a new Closing Auction Session has been introduced for eligible stocks, where continuous trading will halt at 3:15 PM instead of 3:30 PM. This has altered the final closing price calculation methodology for several stocks.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: 54 bank fraud accused fled India, ED seizes assets worth over Rs 35,000 crore
content: The Enforcement Directorate is investigating 32 bank fraud cases with 54 absconding accused.  Proceedings under the Fugitive Economic Offenders Act have been launched against 27 individuals.  Assets worth over Rs 840 crore have been confiscated after nine were declared offenders.  Unclaimed bank deposits transferred to the RBI fund total Rs 62,683.19 crore.  India's foreign exchange reserves remain comfortable, covering 10.3 months of goods imports.

title: Lauren Sanchez worked at waterpark; 40 years later, she takes luxurious ocean trips
content: Lauren Sanchez's career evolved from a teenage waterpark job to ocean conservation leadership. She recently explored the Galápagos Islands, highlighting shark importance for marine health. The Bezos Earth Fund supports significant conservation projects in the Galápagos Marine Reserve. This funding protects vital habitats and migration routes for numerous marine species. Sanchez's work now focuses on protecting vast Pacific waters and their ecosystems.

title: Snail declared extinct in 1996 returns to Norfolk Island after 30 years
content: Campbell's keeled glass snails have reached a major conservation milestone on Norfolk Island. Over one thousand critically endangered snails have now been released onto the island. This marks a significant comeback after the species was presumed lost for decades. The successful recovery program involved extensive collaboration and captive breeding efforts. Researchers will continue monitoring the snails to ensure population growth and survival.

title: Inside the 131-year-old Kathiwada Raaj Mahal’s sustainable luxury
content: Kathiwada Raaj Mahal showcases six centuries of history within the Vindhya hills. Ranasaheb Digvijaysinh Kathiwada leads its preservation and 21st-century relevance. The restored 1895 hunting lodge blends modern comfort with historical elegance. This royal home integrates education, healthcare, and rural development initiatives. The estate aims for sustainable tourism and improved regional infrastructure.

title: US may raise H-1B, L-1 visa fees for large employers under DHS proposal
content: The US government plans to expand an additional visa fee. This fee currently applies to certain large employers filing H-1B and L-1 petitions. The planned change will extend this charge to visa extension requests. Qualifying employers with over fifty employees and a majority in H-1B or L-1 status will be affected. This expansion aims to fund biometric entry-exit system improvements and other government programs.

title: Odisha’s Pucca Ghar Yojana (Mining): Eligibility, process, purpose explained
content: Odisha's Pucca Ghar Yojana is designed to provide durable housing solutions for eligible kutcha households. The initiative focuses on 36 blocks within nine mineral-rich districts impacted by mining. Beneficiaries will receive financial aid for construction, along with assistance for essential services like toilets. To determine eligibility, thorough surveys and checks against existing housing schemes are conducted, with registration available online or via local government officials.

title: ‘Respectful language should still be maintained’: Ex-India captain on abuse against PM Modi
content: Former India football captain Bhaichung Bhutia said citizens have the right to protest but should avoid abusive language, especially against the Prime Minister. Manu Bhaker also urged youngsters to use respectful words. Prime Minister Narendra Modi, meanwhile, said he did not want the protesters punished, calling their actions mistakes and hoping they would learn from them.

title: From apps to 'intent': How AI agents will rewrite the way we use next‑gen phones
content: Smartphones are set to abandon their traditional app icon grids in favor of AI-driven interfaces. Instead of manually opening apps, users will communicate their intentions via voice or text to smart agents that handle tasks seamlessly. This groundbreaking shift heralds a new age of technology, where app stores could evolve into dynamic service registries for these advanced AI agents.

title: Rangers, Canadiens emerge as top landing spots for ex-Kraken $6.95m winger
content: Eeli Tolvanen recorded an impressive performance in the last season with the Seattle Kraken before his contract expired. Ahead of training camp, New York Rangers and the Montreal Canadiens have been linked to him.

title: Michael Jordan’s high school setback sparked basketball’s greatest journey
content: Michael Jordan's famous quote emphasizes accepting failure while not accepting inaction. He believed that learning from mistakes is crucial for personal growth and development. Jordan's own career demonstrated this philosophy through numerous setbacks and comebacks. This mindset continues to inspire individuals across various fields and endeavors. The core message highlights the value of effort over the fear of potential failure.

title: Student housing is India's next real estate hotspot, says report - here's why
content: The surge in India's higher education landscape is driving a notable increase in demand for student accommodation. With international universities thriving and overseas education expenses rising, a remarkable demographic shift is anticipated, projecting over 70 million students by 2035. This educational migration will generate massive housing needs, prompting a significant boost in institutional investments aimed at nationwide accommodation development.

title: 'Will do whatever is necessary': India after Pak deploys 250 Chinese Howitzers
content: India stated it will protect national interests after Pakistan deployed Chinese artillery guns.  Pakistan has reportedly deployed around 250 Chinese-made SH-15 artillery systems.  India criticized Pakistan's recent elections in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir as a farce.  The spokesperson noted civilian deaths during a crackdown in the region.  Both nations continue to modernize their respective artillery capabilities.

title: Vedika Pinto recalls Anurag Kashyap's advice that led her to 'Musafir Cafe'
content: Musafir Cafe breakout star Vedika Pinto tells mid-day how her Nishaanchi director Anurag Kashyap encouraged her to take on the Netflix series, why the show has given her something Nishaanchi couldn't, and what it was like working with National Award winner Vikrant Massey.

title: 'Why the hurry?' Punjab passes anti-E20 resolution, says Centre under US pressure
content: Punjab's Assembly passed a resolution opposing the Centre's E20 fuel policy.  Concerns were raised about potential vehicle damage from the higher ethanol blend.  The state questioned the accelerated rollout and alleged external pressure influenced the decision.  The Aam Aadmi Party is campaigning nationwide against the policy.  They demand consumer choice and lower prices for the blended fuel.

title: Jannat Zubair calls link-up rumours with Elvish Yadav 'a little too much'
content: Jannat Zubair has recently commented on the swirling rumors about her possible romance with Elvish Yadav. While she appreciates the affection shown through fan edits and tribute pages, she emphasizes the need to maintain a clear boundary between professional interactions and personal life. As Yadav gears up for his Bollywood debut, Zubair wishes for their on-screen chemistry to stay just that—on-screen.

title: Rs 15.56 crore: The money behind the medal at 2026 CWG
content: India's 39-medal Commonwealth Games campaign highlighted the impact of the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS), which funds elite athletes through customised training, competition exposure and sports science support. This TimesofIndia.com explainer details how athletes are selected, funded and reviewed, while outlining the government's enhanced investment in high-performance sport as India builds towards the 2036 Games ambitions.

title: Jensen Huang on Asian parenting: 5 lessons from Nvidia CEO's childhood remarks
content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang shared how his Asian parents' constant feedback shaped him.  He explained their criticism was a unique way of showing love and care.  This upbringing taught him to embrace criticism and remain humble throughout his career.  Huang now applies these lessons to his leadership style at Nvidia.  His story highlights the importance of balanced feedback in child development.

title: 'RSS involvement in Sainik Schools rising', says Rahul; Parl panel chief seeks proof
content: Rahul Gandhi alleged increasing RSS involvement in Sainik Schools during a committee meeting. He referred to a media report while making his claim to the panel. The committee chair asked Rahul Gandhi to provide supporting documents for his allegations. Other BJP members also questioned the basis of his statements. Gandhi has previously accused the RSS of capturing public institutions.

title: Spices coated in cloth dye, talcum powder? Hyderabad raids expose food adulteration
content: Over 25,000 kg of hazardous chemical-laced spices were seized during raids. Three people were arrested after inspections uncovered alarming non-compliance with food safety laws. Dangerous practices involved synthetic chemicals, cloth dyes, and shining powder in spices. Strict legal proceedings are initiated against violating business owners under the Food Safety Act. Enforcement drives will continue to ensure safe, unadulterated food products reach consumers.

title: India paves way for return of merchant fees on UPI; what it means
content: Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is the fee merchants pay to banks and payment service providers for processing digital transactions. In India, credit card payments generally attract an MDR of around 1.5%.

title: 'Madrassa pass-outs develop terrorist-like mindset': UP deputy CM Keshav Maurya
content: Speaking to reporters at Vidhan Bhavan, Maurya alleged that madrassa students do not express patriotic slogans and linked their education to extremism. "Anyone who receives a madrassa education does not chant 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai' nor sing 'Vande Mataram', and develops a terrorist-like mindset," he was quoted as saying by news agency PTI. The remarks were strongly criticised by senior Samajwadi Party leader Shivpal Yadav.

title: Drone hunters: How helicopters are becoming the battlefield's new predator
content: Modern battlefields face a significant drone proliferation challenge globally.  Affordable weapons and guided rockets are being adapted for drone interception.  Helicopters are emerging as ideal platforms for effective counter-drone operations.  India is developing indigenous solutions for drone warfare capabilities.  These adaptations aim to address the economic disparity in modern air combat.

title: 'Who is PM Modi to forgive?' Rahul says students 'need apology not forgiveness'
content: In an Instagram video posted on Friday night PM said that he will forgive young protesters accused of abusing him and his late mother, saying they are misguided children and it is “our job to show them the right way” “Nothing is more painful than seeing a parent grieve their child. Behind every young life lost is a family carrying pain that will never leave them - and serious questions about a broken education system,” Gandhi said in a post on X where he also shared images of his interaction with parents and students.

title: 'Never got the credit he deserved': Gavaskar compares Rahane to Dravid
content: Sunil Gavaskar lauded Ajinkya Rahane's leadership during India's historic Australia tour victory. Rahane captained the team through significant challenges and injuries to secure a remarkable series win. Gavaskar noted Rahane's exceptional captaincy record, which often went unappreciated by the public. He highlighted Rahane's crucial century after a devastating defeat, inspiring a comeback. Rahane departs cricket with immense respect from all involved in the sport.

title: 'Private media entity organising it': Govt says 'no role' in Hasina's Aug 5 event
content: The MEA stated no government involvement in a private media event.  The proposed forum concerns former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.  Bangladesh sought clarification from India regarding its support for the event.  Hasina resigned in August 2024 and has been living in Delhi.  She faces a death sentence for crimes against humanity.

title: '2k samples tested': Govt dismisses fuel adulteration claims, says only 2 cases found
content: The Ministry of Petroleum has rolled out enhanced fuel quality measures, implementing water ingress testing that occurs multiple times a day at various fuel stations. In a comprehensive assessment, more than two thousand samples were analyzed for contaminants, revealing minimal problems. Sales were promptly halted at locations with verified contamination. The Ministry warns that stringent penalties will be enforced against any future instances of adulteration.

title: Scientists discover Greenland sharks can see for centuries, debunking blindness myth
content: Recent studies reveal that Greenland sharks possess well-preserved visual systems that can last for centuries, challenging the previous notion that they were nearly blind. Research shows that their eyes are uniquely suited for low-light environments, demonstrating impressive adaptability. Scientists found healthy rod cells and active genes responsible for light detection, indicating these sharks have a remarkable ability to maintain their eyesight throughout their extended lifespans.

title: IAF seeks new high-power sniper rifle for its Garud special forces
content: The Indian Air Force is seeking a new .50 BMG sniper rifle for its Garud Special Forces. This advanced weapon will significantly extend their engagement distances and anti-material capabilities. The Garuds will also receive accompanying equipment like suppressors and thermal scopes. Additionally, the air force is looking for indigenous man-portable loitering munitions for precision strikes. These acquisitions aim to enhance the Garud commandos' operational effectiveness and independent strike power.

title: 'Answered public discontent with bullets': MEA slams Pak over 'farce' PoK polls
content: In a strong statement, the Ministry of External Affairs demanded action against cross-border terrorism, directly targeting groups like Lashkar-e-Taiba following claims about Indian agencies taking down their commanders. They lambasted the local elections in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir as illegitimate, citing repression of civilians by Pakistani forces. Moreover, India urged the global community to address Pakistan's actions firmly.

title: 'Resign, I'll accept within minutes': DKS' blunt warning to disgruntled Cong MLAs
content: In a firm address, Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar cautioned discontented Congress MLAs about the implications of resigning, promising quick acceptance of any such moves. He emphasized the importance of loyalty and patience, drawing from his personal political experiences to underline perseverance. After being sidelined in the recent ministry expansion, two MLAs opted to resign. Shivakumar pledged to create opportunities in state-run boards for those omitted.

title: 'India in a tough position': Ex-cricketer sounds WTC qualification warning
content: India's World Test Championship final hopes depend on the Sri Lanka series. A 2-0 loss would significantly hinder qualification prospects for the Indian team. Winning the series 2-0 improves India's standing but not dramatically. Upcoming away series in New Zealand and Australia present further challenges. India faces a tough schedule with little room for error ahead.

title: 'Decisions at appropriate time': CM Soren on recruitment row as protests intensify
content: Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren addressed recruitment row concerns seriously.  Protesting job aspirants demand an independent probe into examination irregularities.  The state CID investigation is gathering pace with several arrests made.  Former CM Raghubar Das urged dialogue and a CBI inquiry for justice.  The indefinite sit-in continues, with protesters vowing to escalate their agitation.

title: All about Bradley Cooper and Gigi Hadid’s relationship
content: In 2023, Bradley Cooper and Gigi Hadid ignited a romance that blossomed over the years. Their public appearances increased in 2024 as they were spotted at award shows and Broadway. By 2025, conversations about marriage began, signaling a serious commitment. In 2026, wedding speculation surged after they were observed wearing matching bands, hinting at their intentions for a shared future.

content: The top court said the two women members co-opted shall be nominated from among former women High Court judges or senior women members of the Bar.

content: Another reason to believe that the 2027 assembly election will attract more young voters is the fact that students have deferred bachelor's degree programmes at international universities because these degrees no longer guarantee work permits.

content: Police, fire brigade and administrative officials rushed to the spot after receiving information about the incident.

content: According to the data, Maharashtra reported 11 confirmed heatstroke deaths, the highest among all states, followed by Andhra Pradesh with four deaths, Telangana and Odisha with two each, and Tamil Nadu with one.

title: After Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha Clears Registration Of Births And Deaths Bill
content: The bill seeks to amend provisions of the Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 to tighten the existing norms, mandating an order from a judicial magistrate (first class) for birth and death registrations made more than two years after the event.

content: A bench of justices Raja Vijayaraghavan V and K V Jayakumar said that the prosecution has failed to prove the charge of murder against the accused beyond a reasonable doubt.

content: Bessent's comments echoed those of US President Donald Trump on Monday, who insisted the waterway could reopen within hours after he pulled back from threats of a massive military strike on Iran.

title: Watch: Guatemala on high alert as Fuego volcano erupts near capital
content: a nationwide orange alert has been declared nationwide due to the eruption of the Fuego volcano . the alert level is one below the highest red warning, which indicates the most serious emergency . officials began evacuating two villages near the volcano, which sits about 35 kilometres from Guatemala City .

title: Crackdown on digital fraud: SC orders action, gives strict directions to RBI
content: the apex court directed banks, financial intermediaries, regulators and law enforcement agencies to work together to curb the rising menace of "digital arrest" scams . the court called for a coordinated institutional response, including faster grievance redressal, stronger mechanisms to restore victims' money and wider public awareness campaigns .
